segments.name: Splash Beverage
segments.description: Manufactures and distributes non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages for its customers, including the Chispo Tequila brand.
segments.evidence: We have two reportable operating segments: (1) the manufacture and distribution of non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages, and (2) the retail sale of beverages and groceries online.

segments.name: E-Commerce
segments.description: Sells beverages and groceries online at retail to its customers.
segments.evidence: We have two reportable operating segments: (1) the manufacture and distribution of non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages, and (2) the retail sale of beverages and groceries online.

revenueModel.text: Distributors and retail accounts pay for beverages the company ships to them, and online shoppers pay for beverages and groceries.
revenueModel.evidence: In March 2026, we shipped initial inventory to a distributor which we expect will permit us to recognize revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2026.
